blocks.html: Emergency alarms for notification of an emergency condition in a Hazardous Production Material (HPM) facility shall be provided as required in Section 415.11.3.5. A continuous gas detection system shall be provided for HPM gases in accordance with Section 415.11.7 of this code and the New York City Fire Code.
